title: lolium multiflorum var. compositum
intro: Lolium multiflorum var. compositum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Italian ryegrass include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and exhibit potential anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of Italian ryegrass include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
